dashboard.title: SEO Overview
dashboard.subtitle: Monitor your websites, technical audits, and performance from one unified dashboard.

projects.title: Monitored Websites
projects.subtitle: Websites added to your workspace and their latest technical audit results.
projects.click_depth_desc: Defines how many link hops from the homepage the crawler will navigate. Google recommends keeping important content within 3 clicks of the homepage.

ai_seo.title: AI Search Readiness
ai_seo.subtitle: Evaluate your website's discoverability, citation potential, and crawling rules across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude.
ai_seo.readiness_desc: Measured by AI bot crawling permissions, llms.txt standard files, structured knowledge graphs, and semantic content depth.
ai_seo.knowledge_desc: LLMs rely directly on structured JSON-LD schemas to synthesize trustworthy answers about your brand and products.
ai_seo.bots_permission_desc: Rules configured in your robots.txt file for generative AI and search agents.
ai_seo.impact_allowed: Can cite and browse your site in generated answers
ai_seo.impact_blocked: Model cannot access or index content directly
ai_seo.merger_desc: Fetched directly from your live website. Preserves 100% of your existing rules while appending optimal AI agent directives.
ai_seo.status_fetched: Original robots.txt successfully fetched from your site
ai_seo.status_not_found: No robots.txt found on your site; generated fresh standard AI template
ai_seo.status_preserve_notice: None of your existing rules (Disallow etc.) are altered or deleted. Required access rules for ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Siri are safely appended at the end.
ai_seo.guide_step1_desc: Download or copy the merged robots.txt content above.
ai_seo.guide_step2_desc: Save it to your website root directory (e.g. public_html/robots.txt).
ai_seo.guide_step3_desc: ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude can now index your website without friction.
ai_seo.llms_desc: Save this file as public_html/llms.txt on your domain for next-generation AI indexing.
